name: status
description: read the state of the instrument: state, initialised, homed, fault, temperature, gap, time and run id; the mock adapter in this bundle stands in for the instrument

fault.description: null, or a sentence that says what the fault is

time.description: the documentation names it and states no type

run_id.description: the documentation names it and states no type

safety_gate.place: the tool reads the instrument and changes nothing; src/gate.py is consulted by the runner and finds no gate required
